project.description: Things made ahead and kept: each a leaf of a tree, made as finely as asked (coarse, middling or fine), by a recipe saying which of those are dear to make. The dear ones looked for where they are kept first and made only if not there, then kept; the cheap ones made each time. Kept, to begin with, in folders laid out as the trees are, one to each leaf, a file to each resolution; each file saying what code made it, so a thing made by code since changed is made again. Not assets: only what was worked out, kept against working it out again.
